fullBio: I'm Abdul Malik Hussain, a Senior Campaign Manager based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. I joined iOPEX Technologies as a Media Analyst and was promoted to Senior Campaign Manager within my first year.

Today, I manage $4–5M+ in monthly paid media spend across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and YouTube for a multi-market portfolio spanning home services, retail, healthcare, real estate, powersports, and higher education.

With a background in Mechanical Engineering, I approach growth with analytical precision: isolating winning search queries, optimizing smart bidding signals, scaling high-hook creative, and cutting wasted spend. That methodology drove a 141% YoY increase in qualified leads while reducing cost-per-lead by 56% on an anchor account.

Over my tenure, I've secured over $500K in client budget expansion across retail, healthcare, and home improvement verticals, while training new media analysts and producing high-converting paid social creative assets.
